svg.title: PIR®, Psychedelics In Recovery™
svg.desc: The PIR® mark beside a night sky breathing toward daybreak. Constellations draw themselves in and fade: the eye in the diamond traced in stars, the Three Legacies (Recovery, Unity, Service) and the Fellowship's circle of twelve. Faint threads join the stars like mycelium, and soft pulses of light travel them, star to star, and stars glint as the light arrives. A safe, sacred space to integrate and discuss the role of psychedelics in your recovery journey.
